course_name_original: Grundlagen der Betriebswirtschaft und des Gründertums
course_name_en: Fundamentals of Business Administration and Entrepreneurship
prerequisites: Second study section achieved (at least 42 ECTS points from the first study section must be proven).

learning_outcomes.text: Describe the essential characteristics of corporate responsible action.
Understand the fundamentals of globalization and the market economy.
Distinguish market forms and economic areas, as well as sales policy and marketing mix.
Describe corporate organization and corporate structures.
Describe the essential characteristics and procedures of innovation management.
Name different leadership styles and explain various forms of personnel organization.
Understand the essential aspects of entrepreneurship, such as basic knowledge of financing, accounting, and investment calculation, and apply them in a practical context.
Name fundamental forms of material and production management.

syllabus_topics: Basic concepts (goals, constitutive decisions such as legal form and cooperations, decision rules)
Fundamentals of globalization and market economy
Market forms and economic areas, sales policy and marketing mix
Fundamentals of material and production management
Basic knowledge of financing, accounting and investment calculation
Conceptual aspects - Business plan, Business Model Canvas, Entrepreneur Marketing, Corporate Culture
assessment_rules: The examination is a 90-minute written exam.
